# DepthFillAll

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Editing` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed class DepthFillAll : RegionEditCommand<DepthPixel>
```

Sets every solid pixel to one front/back depth, replacing whatever was there.
